proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: $1.80 free credit upon registration. Flux.1 Schnell costs $0.0006 per image (approx. 3,000 free images). No daily expiration.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Provides lightning-fast API endpoints for Flux.1 Schnell, Dev, and SDXL with zero IP blocking on GitHub Actions runner environments. Extremely cheap pay-as-you-go if the free tier runs out.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Can be integrated directly into 'produce_coloring_book' and 'produce_kdp_cover' via standard python requests, replacing Pollinations for professional-grade assets.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Requires setting up an account and storing a DEEPINFRA_API_KEY. Card registration might be needed to unlock the free credits in some regions.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: No monthly fee. Zero cost to set up. Takes a 5% + $0.50 transaction fee only on successful sales.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Acts as a Merchant of Record. They automatically calculate, collect, and remit EU VAT (TVA) on digital downloads (like PDF coloring books or gamedev assets). This saves Hugo in France from massive administrative tax burdens.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Distribution channel for digital PDF coloring books generated by 'produce_coloring_book' and assets from 'produce_gamedev_asset_pack'.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Payout thresholds apply. Payouts are processed globally but might have a slight delay compared to direct Stripe integrations.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 100 free credits daily, refreshed every 24 hours. Flux.1 Schnell costs 1 credit per generation.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Offers fine-tuned models, ControlNet, and Flux APIs. The daily renewing free tier is highly sustainable for daily cron-scheduled GitHub Actions tasks.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Scheduled daily automated design runs in GitHub Actions to build a catalog of designs without spending a cent.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: API rate limits on the free tier can trigger 429 errors if multiple GitHub Action jobs run concurrently.

proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Enables programmatic conversion of raster images (PNG/JPG) into high-quality vector formats (SVG/EPS/PDF) using their advanced vectorization engine via API.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Post-processing step in 'produce_coloring_book' and 'produce_svg_pack' to convert AI-generated line art into infinitely scalable SVGs for professional POD buyers.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: High-resolution vectorization can consume more conversion minutes per file, limiting daily output to ~15-20 files on the free tier.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: Free developer account, full API access, up to 5 stores per account.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Allows programmatically creating mockups, uploading designs, and publishing products to linked stores (Etsy, Pop-up stores) without clicking through web interfaces.
proposals.would_integrate_where: A new automated pipeline 'produce_pod_automation' that automatically generates a design, pushes it to Printify, and publishes it to a store via API from GitHub Actions.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Complex payload structure for product creation; requires setting up shipping profiles beforehand.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: Free to list models, free storage, optional paid memberships for sellers with standard platform transaction fees.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: A massive, high-growth search engine and marketplace specifically for 3D printing enthusiasts. Often outpaces Cults3D for organic discoverability of functional or artistic STL files.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Distribution channel for parametric assets generated by 'produce_stl_parametric'.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: No direct public API for automated uploads; requires manual upload or browser automation via Termux/Puppeteer if automated.
